Fees and funding
Find out about the costs and financial support available for your studies
When planning your university course, it’s important to consider the costs associated with your studies. Whether it’s an undergraduate, postgraduate or research degree you’re applying for, there are various fees, and funding, associated with them.
Choose the stage of studies relevant to you and see the tuition fees, bursaries, funding and support available.
If you're interested in our undergraduate or postgraduate scholarships, please use our search page to find the best one for you.
